text.description_html:
Acorn AZC-202-3, Deco Nouveau Stainless Steel 3 Inch Cabinet Pull

Perfect for both modern and traditional style homes, this stainless steel cabinet pull made by Acorn is a great way to update all your cabinet hardware. It is simple enough to transition from one ascetic to the next while still being attractive enough to add a little pizzazz to any room. What is great about the Deco Nouveau pull is that it is timeless--blending seamlessly from retro spaces to contemporary ones and everything in between. This cabinet pull makes it easy to revive your decor by simply replacing the existing hardware without having to remodel everything around it.

Also Available: 3.5 Inch Center to Center Deco Nouveau Cabinet Pull and 4 Inch Center to Center Deco Nouveau Cabinet Pull

Specifications for the Absolute Zero Collection Deco Nouveau Cabinet Pull Acorn AZC-202-3:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length (c.c hole spacing): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4.5"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel.

Sold Individually
